ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New accounts, Terms agreed and later stages need Amount, Close date and Credit approved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_accounts", CASE(StageName, "Identified", 1, "First contact", 2, "Needs confirmed", 3, "Sample or trial", 4, "Quote issued", 5, "Terms agreed", 6, "Closed won", 7, 0) >= 6, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(CloseDate), NOT(Credit_approved__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Close date and Credit approved before moving to Terms agreed.
